subject: Kinswell Therapeutics — request for extended evaluation credits and window
messages:

To: Deal Desk <deal-desk@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Roberts <emma.roberts@kinswell.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kinswell Therapeutics — request for extended evaluation credits and window

Hi Deal Desk team,

Quick background: Kinswell (prospect) is in a deep ML evaluation for an internal drug-discovery workflow. They ran into throughput limits during a series of longer sequence experiments and asked for additional free credits + a 30-day extension to the POC. Their current PLG allotment (standard trial credits + 14-day window) is insufficient to complete their benchmark run.

Ask: Can we approve an one-time, non-standard uplift of 200k token credits and extend their evaluation window by 30 days? The prospect is asking for this to finish a fidelity run that directly maps to procurement timing; if they complete the benchmark in this window, they will sign a 12-month Dedicated capacity commitment (forecasted ARR: ~$280k).

Notes:
- Deal ID: DL-2027-0892
- Related docs attached: Kinswell-Eval-MAP.xlsx (workload profile), SOW-draft-Kinswell.pdf (provisional)
- We're requesting a conditional approval: credits granted contingent on executing the SOW draft and a 60% commit to the initial quarter; marketing/CS will be on standby for onboarding.

Would appreciate an expedited decision — they asked for confirmation by EOD Thursday PT to avoid pausing the experiment.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0136

Attachment: Kinswell-Eval-MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: SOW-draft-Kinswell.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kinswell Therapeutics — request for extended evaluation credits and window

Evelyn — thanks for the ask and the context. A few clarifying questions before I take to Jonas for exec approval:

1) Can you confirm the 200k tokens map to roughly X GPU hours in your MAP? (I see a rough estimate in the spreadsheet but need it in the form we track for forecasting.)
2) Is the 30-day extension starting from their current trial end date (03/15) or from approval date?
3) Proposed guardrails: we typically require a short form acceptance (email ok) of the SOW draft and a PO trigger threshold (e.g., 60% of Q1 expected consumption). Can we get Kinswell to sign the short form before uplift?

If the answers are yes, I can recommend a one-time exception with the following constraints: 200k tokens, 30-day extension, requires short-form SOW acceptance and commit-to-purchase note. Escalation to Jonas if they want credits >200k or a longer window.

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk Operations

Hi Evelyn / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick follow. Confirming a few details from our side:
- The workload profile in the MAP is accurate — 200k tokens would allow us to complete the remaining fidelity runs (approx. 48 GPU hours on an LLM-2-type instance).
- The 30-day window should start from 03/15 (current trial end) to keep internal scheduling aligned.
- We can sign a short-form SOW (one-page acceptance) by Thursday EOD if Redwood can approve the credits by then.

We appreciate the team's flexibility — completing these runs is critical to our board review and procurement timelines.

Best,

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — one-time credit uplift for Kinswell (DL-2027-0892)

Jonas — quick ask: can you sign off on the conditional exception below? Client is willing to sign a one-page SOW acceptance; they need confirmation by 03/11 EOD PT.

Proposal I recommend:
- Grant 200,000 token credits
- Extend trial window by 30 days (03/15 -> 04/14)
- Requirement: Kinswell signs short-form SOW and confirms intent to execute a PO for at least 60% of expected Q1 consumption within 14 days of the uplift
- Accounting note: credits will be tracked as one-off marketing/sales expense; CS will monitor for abnormal usage patterns.

If you prefer, we can reduce credits to 150k and require immediate PO to reduce risk. Please advise urgently — deadline tomorrow EOD.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Evelyn

--forwarded: Kinswell MAP and SOW stubs attached--

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: APPROVED: Kinswell conditional uplift (DL-2027-0892)

Evelyn / Marissa — approved with the following conditions (please confirm once met):

1) Grant the requested 200,000 token credits and extend the trial window to 04/14/2027.
2) Obtain a signed short-form SOW acceptance (one page) from Kinswell before applying credits. Store the executed copy in the HubSpot deal record.
3) Require a written commitment (email is ok) confirming intent to submit a PO for at least 60% of the forecasted Q1 consumption within 14 days of uplift. If they fail to provide confirmation, credits will be paused and reviewed by Deal Desk.
4) Mark this as a non-precedent exception and record finance charge code: MKT-POC-UPLIFT-2027.

Evelyn — please reply-all to confirm when the SOW is received and attach the signed copy. Marissa — please flag to finance for one-off treatment.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
